summary: Automatic aircraft photography: the EFB finds a photo of the exact aircraft you are flying, with clearly labelled stand-ins when it cannot.
releaseNotes: Automatic aircraft photos in the EFB flight widget, by registration from X-Plane or MSFS, with the photographer's credit and a link to Planespotters.
When the exact aircraft has no photo: the aircraft flying your flight today, the same airline and type, the same type, or an illustration, each clearly labelled.
Find image retries the search, and Set reg adds a backup registration.
MSFS now reports the aircraft type and airline; X-Plane follows a switch to another aircraft.
Photo lookups are cached, spaced out and retried, so they never slow the simulator.
